verses.original: וַיַּ֗עַל נָחָשׁ֙ הָֽעַמּוֹנִ֔י וַיִּ֖חַן עַל־ יָבֵ֣שׁ גִּלְעָ֑ד וַיֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ כָּל־ אַנְשֵׁ֤י יָבֵישׁ֙ אֶל־ נָחָ֔שׁ כְּרָת־ לָ֥נוּ בְרִ֖ית וְנַעַבְדֶֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al nā·ḥāš hā·‘am·mō·w·nî way·yi·ḥan ‘al- yā·ḇêš gil·‘āḏ way·yō·mə·rū kāl- ’an·šê yā·ḇêš ’el- nā·ḥāš kə·rāṯ- lā·nū ḇə·rîṯ wə·na·‘aḇ·ḏe·kā
verses.literal: Then Nahash the Ammonite came up and laid siege to Jabesh-gilead . . . All the men of Jabesh said to him Make a treaty with us and we will serve you
verses.literalPt: ENTÃO subiu Naás, amonita, e sitiou a Jabes-Gileade; e disseram todos os homens de Jabes a Naás: Faze aliança conosco, e te serviremos.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם נָחָשׁ֙ הָעַמּוֹנִ֔י בְּזֹאת֙ אֶכְרֹ֣ת לָכֶ֔ם בִּנְק֥וֹר לָכֶ֖ם כָּל־ עֵ֣ין יָמִ֑ין וְשַׂמְתִּ֥יהָ חֶרְפָּ֖ה עַל־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem nā·ḥāš hā·‘am·mō·w·nî bə·zōṯ ’eḵ·rōṯ lā·ḵem bin·qō·wr lā·ḵem kāl- ‘ên yā·mîn wə·śam·tî·hā ḥer·pāh ‘al- kāl- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: But Nahash the Ammonite replied . . . I will make a treaty with you on one condition that I may put out everyone’s right eye and bring reproach upon all Israel
verses.literalPt: Porém Naás, amonita, lhes disse: Com esta condição farei aliança convosco: que a todos vos arranque o olho direito, e assim ponha esta afronta sobre todo o Israel.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֨וּ אֵלָ֜יו זִקְנֵ֣י יָבֵ֗ישׁ הֶ֤רֶף לָ֙נוּ֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים וְנִשְׁלְחָה֙ מַלְאָכִ֔ים בְּכֹ֖ל גְּב֣וּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְאִם־ אֵ֥ין מוֹשִׁ֛יעַ אֹתָ֖נוּ וְיָצָ֥אנוּ אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’ê·lāw ziq·nê yā·ḇêš he·rep̄ lā·nū šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm wə·niš·lə·ḥāh mal·’ā·ḵîm bə·ḵōl gə·ḇūl yiś·rā·’êl wə·’im- ’ên mō·wō·šî·a‘ ’ō·ṯā·nū wə·yā·ṣā·nū ’ê·le·ḵā
verses.literal: Hold off for seven days replied the elders of Jabesh and let us send messengers throughout Israel If there is no one to save us we will surrender to you
verses.literalPt: Então os anciãos de Jabes lhe disseram: Deixa-nos por sete dias, para que enviemos mensageiros por todos os termos de Israel, e, não havendo ninguém que nos livre, então viremos a ti.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֤אוּ הַמַּלְאָכִים֙ גִּבְעַ֣ת שָׁא֔וּל וַיְדַבְּר֥וּ הַדְּבָרִ֖ים בְּאָזְנֵ֣י הָעָ֑ם וַיִּשְׂא֧וּ כָל־ הָעָ֛ם אֶת־ קוֹלָ֖ם וַיִּבְכּֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū ham·mal·’ā·ḵîm giḇ·‘aṯ šā·’ūl way·ḏab·bə·rū had·də·ḇā·rîm bə·’ā·zə·nê hā·‘ām way·yiś·’ū ḵāl hā·‘ām ’eṯ- qō·w·lām way·yiḇ·kū
verses.literal: When the messengers came to Gibeah of Saul and relayed these words in the hearing of the people they all . . . wept aloud . . .
verses.literalPt: E, vindo os mensageiros a Gibeá de Saul, falaram estas palavras aos ouvidos do povo. Então todo o povo levantou a sua voz, e chorou.

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֣ה שָׁא֗וּל בָּ֣א אַחֲרֵ֤י הַבָּקָר֙ מִן־ הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁא֔וּל מַה־ לָּעָ֖ם כִּ֣י יִבְכּ֑וּ וַיְסַ֨פְּרוּ־ ל֔וֹ אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֖י אַנְשֵׁ֥י יָבֵֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh šā·’ūl bā ’a·ḥă·rê hab·bā·qār min- haś·śā·ḏeh way·yō·mer šā·’ūl mah- lā·‘ām kî yiḇ·kū way·sap·pə·rū- lōw ’eṯ- diḇ·rê ’an·šê yā·ḇêš
verses.literal: Just then Saul was returning from the field behind his oxen What troubles the people asked Saul Why are they weeping And they relayed to him the words of the men from Jabesh
verses.literalPt: E eis que Saul vinha do campo, atrás dos bois; e disse Saul: Que tem o povo, que chora? E contaram-lhe as palavras dos homens de Jabes.

verses.original: וַתִּצְלַ֤ח רֽוּחַ־ אֱלֹהִים֙ עַל־ שָׁא֔וּל בְּשָׁמְעוֹ אֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה וַיִּ֥חַר אַפּ֖וֹ מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiṣ·laḥ rū·aḥ- ’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘al- šā·’ūl bə·šå̄·mə·ʿō ’eṯ- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh way·yi·ḥar ’ap·pōw mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: When Saul heard their words the Spirit of God rushed upon him and he burned with great anger . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Então o Espírito de Deus se apoderou de Saul, ouvindo estas palavras; e acendeu-se em grande maneira a sua ira.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּח֩ צֶ֨מֶד בָּקָ֜ר וַֽיְנַתְּחֵ֗הוּ וַיְשַׁלַּ֞ח בְּכָל־ גְּב֣וּל יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ בְּיַ֣ד הַמַּלְאָכִ֣ים׀ לֵאמֹר֒ אֲשֶׁר֩ אֵינֶ֨נּוּ יֹצֵ֜א אַחֲרֵ֤י שָׁאוּל֙ וְאַחַ֣ר שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל כֹּ֥ה יֵעָשֶׂ֖ה לִבְקָר֑וֹ וַיִּפֹּ֤ל פַּֽחַד־ יְהוָה֙ עַל־ הָעָ֔ם וַיֵּצְא֖וּ כְּאִ֥ישׁ אֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ ṣe·meḏ bā·qār way·nat·tə·ḥê·hū way·šal·laḥ bə·ḵāl gə·ḇūl yiś·rā·’êl bə·yaḏ ham·mal·’ā·ḵîm lê·mōr ’ă·šer ’ê·nen·nū yō·ṣê ’a·ḥă·rê šā·’ūl wə·’a·ḥar šə·mū·’êl kōh yê·‘ā·śeh liḇ·qā·rōw way·yip·pōl pa·ḥaḏ- Yah·weh ‘al- hā·‘ām way·yê·ṣə·’ū kə·’îš ’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: He took a pair of oxen cut them into pieces and sent them by messengers throughout the land of Israel proclaiming This is what will be done to the oxen of anyone who does not march behind Saul . . . and Samuel Then the terror of the LORD fell upon the people and they came out together as one man
verses.literalPt: E tomou uma junta de bois, e cortou-os em pedaços, e os enviou a todos os termos de Israel pelas mãos dos mensageiros, dizendo: Qualquer que não seguir a Saul e a Samuel, assim se fará aos seus bois. Então caiu o temor do SENHOR sobre o povo, e saíram como um só homem.

verses.original: וַֽיִּפְקְדֵ֖ם בְּבָ֑זֶק וַיִּהְי֤וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ שְׁלֹ֣שׁ מֵא֣וֹת אֶ֔לֶף וְאִ֥ישׁ יְהוּדָ֖ה שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אָֽלֶף׃
verses.transliteration: way·yip̄·qə·ḏêm bə·ḇā·zeq way·yih·yū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl šə·lōš mê·’ō·wṯ ’e·lep̄ wə·’îš yə·hū·ḏāh šə·lō·šîm ’ā·lep̄
verses.literal: And when Saul numbered them at Bezek there were 300,000 . . . . . . Israelites . . . and 30,000 . . . men of Judah
verses.literalPt: E contou-os em Bezeque; e houve dos filhos de Israel trezentos mil, e dos homens de Judá trinta mil.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֞וּ לַמַּלְאָכִ֣ים הַבָּאִ֗ים כֹּ֤ה תֹֽאמְרוּן֙ לְאִישׁ֙ יָבֵ֣ישׁ גִּלְעָ֔ד מָחָ֛ר תִּהְיֶֽה־ לָכֶ֥ם תְּשׁוּעָ֖ה בְּחֹם הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ הַמַּלְאָכִ֗ים וַיַּגִּ֛ידוּ לְאַנְשֵׁ֥י יָבֵ֖ישׁ וַיִּשְׂמָֽחוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū lam·mal·’ā·ḵîm hab·bā·’îm kōh ṯō·mə·rūn lə·’îš yā·ḇêš gil·‘āḏ mā·ḥār tih·yeh- lā·ḵem tə·šū·‘āh bə·ḥōm haš·šā·meš way·yā·ḇō·’ū ham·mal·’ā·ḵîm way·yag·gî·ḏū lə·’an·šê yā·ḇêš way·yiś·mā·ḥū
verses.literal: So they said to the messengers who had come Tell the men of Jabesh-gilead . . . Deliverance will be yours tomorrow by the time the sun . . . is hot And when the messengers relayed this to the men of Jabesh they rejoiced
verses.literalPt: Então disseram aos mensageiros que vieram: Assim direis aos homens de Jabes-Gileade: Amanhã, em aquecendo o sol, vos virá livramento. Vindo, pois, os mensageiros, e anunciando-o aos homens de Jabes, se alegraram.

verses.original: וַֽיֹּאמְרוּ֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י יָבֵ֔ישׁ מָחָ֖ר נֵצֵ֣א אֲלֵיכֶ֑ם וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֣ם לָּ֔נוּ כְּכָל־ הַטּ֖וֹב בְּעֵינֵיכֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’an·šê yā·ḇêš mā·ḥār nê·ṣê ’ă·lê·ḵem wa·‘ă·śî·ṯem lā·nū kə·ḵāl- haṭ·ṭō·wḇ bə·‘ê·nê·ḵem
verses.literal: Then the men of Jabesh said to Nahash Tomorrow we will come out . . . and you can do with us whatever seems good to you
verses.literalPt: E os homens de Jabes disseram aos amonitas: Amanhã sairemos a vós; então nos fareis conforme a tudo o que parecer bem aos vossos olhos.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י מִֽמָּחֳרָ֗ת וַיָּ֨שֶׂם שָׁא֣וּל אֶת־ הָעָם֮ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה רָאשִׁים֒ וַיָּבֹ֤אוּ בְתוֹךְ־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶה֙ בְּאַשְׁמֹ֣רֶת הַבֹּ֔קֶר וַיַּכּ֥וּ אֶת־ עַמּ֖וֹן עַד־ חֹ֣ם הַיּ֑וֹם וַיְהִ֤י הַנִּשְׁאָרִים֙ וַיָּפֻ֔צוּ וְלֹ֥א נִשְׁאֲרוּ־ בָ֖ם שְׁנַ֥יִם יָֽחַד׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî mim·mā·ḥo·rāṯ way·yā·śem šā·’ūl ’eṯ- hā·‘ām šə·lō·šāh rā·šîm way·yā·ḇō·’ū ḇə·ṯō·wḵ- ham·ma·ḥă·neh bə·’aš·mō·reṯ hab·bō·qer way·yak·kū ’eṯ- ‘am·mō·wn ‘aḏ- ḥōm hay·yō·wm way·hî han·niš·’ā·rîm way·yā·p̄u·ṣū wə·lō niš·’ă·rū- ḇām šə·na·yim yā·ḥaḏ
verses.literal: The next day Saul organized the troops into three divisions and during the morning watch they invaded . . . the camp of the Ammonites and slaughtered them until the hottest part of the day And the survivors were so scattered that no two of them were left together
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que ao outro dia Saul pôs o povo em três companhias, e vieram ao meio do arraial pela vigília da manhã, e feriram aos amonitas até que o dia aqueceu; e sucedeu que os restantes se espalharam, de modo que não ficaram dois deles juntos.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר הָעָם֙ אֶל־ שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל מִ֣י הָאֹמֵ֔ר שָׁא֖וּל יִמְלֹ֣ךְ עָלֵ֑ינוּ תְּנ֥וּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים וּנְמִיתֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer hā·‘ām ’el- šə·mū·’êl mî hā·’ō·mêr šā·’ūl yim·lōḵ ‘ā·lê·nū tə·nū hā·’ă·nā·šîm ū·nə·mî·ṯêm
verses.literal: Then the people said to Samuel Who said that Saul should not reign over us Bring those men here so we can kill them
verses.literalPt: Então disse o povo a Samuel: Quem é aquele que dizia que Saul não reinaria sobre nós? Dai-nos aqueles homens, e os mataremos.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁא֔וּל לֹֽא־ יוּמַ֥ת אִ֖ישׁ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה כִּ֥י הַיּ֛וֹם עָשָֽׂה־ יְהוָ֥ה תְּשׁוּעָ֖ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šā·’ūl lō- yū·maṯ ’îš bay·yō·wm haz·zeh kî hay·yō·wm ‘ā·śāh- Yah·weh tə·šū·‘āh bə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: But Saul ordered No one shall be put to death this day for today the LORD has worked salvation in Israel
verses.literalPt: Porém Saul disse: Hoje não morrerá nenhum, pois hoje tem feito o SENHOR um livramento em Israel.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל֙ אֶל־ הָעָ֔ם לְכ֖וּ וְנֵלְכָ֣ה הַגִּלְגָּ֑ל וּנְחַדֵּ֥שׁ שָׁ֖ם הַמְּלוּכָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šə·mū·’êl ’el- hā·‘ām lə·ḵū wə·nê·lə·ḵāh hag·gil·gāl ū·nə·ḥad·dêš šām ham·mə·lū·ḵāh
verses.literal: Then Samuel said to the people Come let us go to Gilgal and renew the kingship there
verses.literalPt: E disse Samuel ao povo: Vinde, vamos nós a Gilgal, e renovemos ali o reino.

verses.original: וַיֵּלְכ֨וּ כָל־ הָעָ֜ם הַגִּלְגָּ֗ל וַיַּמְלִכוּ֩ שָׁ֨ם אֶת־ שָׁא֜וּל לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ בַּגִּלְגָּ֔ל וַיִּזְבְּחוּ־ שָׁ֛ם זְבָחִ֥ים שְׁלָמִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּשְׂמַ֨ח שָׁ֥ם שָׁא֛וּל וְכָל־ אַנְשֵׁ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַד־ מְאֹֽד׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yê·lə·ḵū ḵāl hā·‘ām hag·gil·gāl way·yam·li·ḵū šām ’eṯ- šā·’ūl lip̄·nê Yah·weh bag·gil·gāl way·yiz·bə·ḥū- šām zə·ḇā·ḥîm šə·lā·mîm lip̄·nê Yah·weh way·yiś·maḥ šām šā·’ūl wə·ḵāl ’an·šê yiś·rā·’êl ‘aḏ- mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: So all the people went to Gilgal and confirmed Saul as king in the presence of the LORD . . . There they sacrificed peace offerings before the LORD and Saul and all the Israelites rejoiced . . . greatly . . .
verses.literalPt: E todo o povo partiu para Gilgal, onde proclamaram a Saul por rei perante o SENHOR, e ofereceram ali ofertas pacíficas perante o SENHOR; e Saul se alegrou muito ali com todos os homens de Israel.
